purpose: Classify BIS report products by audience, permitted evidence, permitted claims and privacy boundary.

products.purpose: Explain the learner's evidence-backed progression, what changed, what remains open and the next practice/pathway.
products.privacy: Learner-owned; may use the learner's own evidence, but default presentation should synthesise rather than replay every raw response.

products.purpose: Show where facilitation, clarification, access or experiment support is needed.
mayInclude: approved competency stage where the evidence contract permits it
safeguarding/escalation signals through existing governed routes

products.purpose: Show how the cohort is progressing across the programme's authored competency map.
mustNotClaim: causal impact without design/evidence that supports it
products.privacy: Cohort-first; individual drill-down only where role and evidence policy explicitly allow it.

products.purpose: Explain what the programme delivered, what evidence was produced, what progression is supported and what remains uncertain.
mayInclude: limitations and comparison to agreed success criteria
mustNotClaim: durable capability from a single short cycle

products.purpose: Assemble source-linked evidence of learning, application, review and transfer into a durable narrative of growth and next steps.
mustNotClaim: that one successful attempt proves mastery
products.privacy: Learner-owned portfolio; sharing is a separate governed action.

governingRule: The same event may contribute to different report products only within each product's claim and privacy boundary. Report audience never upgrades the strength of the underlying evidence.
